content: This image shows a minimalist silhouette illustration of an elephant against a teal blue background. The elephant is depicted in dark brown or black, creating a strong contrast with the background. The elephant's distinctive trunk and tusk are clearly visible in the silhouette. The bottom portion of the image has a dark horizontal band, giving the impression that the elephant is standing on solid ground or against a horizon. This type of simple, clean graphic design is often used in logos, posters, or modern artistic representations of wildlife.
